headline: US lowers Bangladesh travel advisory from Level 3 to Level 2
summary: The update reflects growing US confidence in the country's security environment and stability, following high-level bilateral talks in Dhaka.
details: The United States has updated its travel advisory for Bangladesh, shifting the status from Level 3 (Reconsider Travel) to Level 2 (Exercise Increased Caution).
The foreign ministry announced the change today, noting that the overall advisory has been lowered, signaling that Bangladesh is now considered safer for international travel.
This development follows a bilateral meeting in Dhaka on Thursday between Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman and US Special Envoy Sergio Gor.
According to the foreign ministry, Special Envoy Sergio Gor conveyed the update to the Foreign Minister via a text message immediately after their meeting.
The US government's decision reflects an increasing confidence in Bangladesh's overall security environment and stability.
The Bangladesh government views this improvement as recognition of its sustained efforts to ensure security and an enabling environment for trade, investment, and people-to-people connectivity.
caption:
Bangladesh is now safer for US travelers. The US has officially lowered its travel advisory level for the country.

The United States has updated its travel advisory for Bangladesh, shifting the status from Level 3 (Reconsider Travel) to Level 2 (Exercise Increased Caution).

The foreign ministry announced the change today, noting that the overall advisory has been lowered, signaling that Bangladesh is now considered safer for international travel.

This development follows a bilateral meeting in Dhaka on Thursday between Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman and US Special Envoy Sergio Gor.

According to the foreign ministry, Special Envoy Sergio Gor conveyed the update to the Foreign Minister via a text message immediately after their meeting.

The US government's decision reflects an increasing confidence in Bangladesh's overall security environment and stability.

The Bangladesh government views this improvement as recognition of its sustained efforts to ensure security and an enabling environment for trade, investment, and people-to-people connectivity.

headline_marked: Bangladesh Bank [[warns against crypto and MLM scams]]
headline: Bangladesh Bank warns against crypto and MLM scams
summary: The central bank has issued a warning to the public regarding financial fraud involving cryptocurrency and multi-level marketing schemes.
details: Bangladesh Bank has issued a formal warning to citizens to be cautious of financial scams operating under the guise of cryptocurrency and multi-level marketing (MLM) schemes.
The central bank highlighted that these schemes often promise high returns on investment to lure unsuspecting individuals into investing their hard-earned money.
Authorities warned that such activities are not authorized by the central bank and lack legal backing in the country.
The public is advised to avoid investing in unauthorized platforms and to verify the legitimacy of any financial institution before committing funds.
caption:
Beware of 'high return' promises! Bangladesh Bank warns against crypto and MLM scams.

Bangladesh Bank has issued a formal warning to citizens to be cautious of financial scams operating under the guise of cryptocurrency and multi-level marketing (MLM) schemes.

The central bank highlighted that these schemes often promise high returns on investment to lure unsuspecting individuals into investing their hard-earned money.

Authorities warned that such activities are not authorized by the central bank and lack legal backing in the country.

The public is advised to avoid investing in unauthorized platforms and to verify the legitimacy of any financial institution before committing funds.
